# CXDMO

> CXDMO (Contract X Development & Manufacturing Organization) industry news portal —
> tracking WuXi AppTec, WuXi Biologics, WuXi XDC, Pharmaron, Asymchem, Porton,
> Samsung Biologics and Lonza. Results, capacity, M&A and partnerships.

## Pages
- [Home](https://cxdmo.com/): hero, top story and latest news (22 total stories).
- [News](https://cxdmo.com/news.html): filterable by segment, category and keyword.
- [Companies](https://cxdmo.com/companies.html): profiles for 9 tracked CXDMO organizations.
- [About](https://cxdmo.com/about.html): what is a CXDMO, sources and disclaimer.

## Companies tracked
- [WuXi AppTec (药明康德)](https://www.wuxiapptec.cn/): 小分子 CRDMO 一体化平台
- [WuXi Biologics (药明生物)](https://www.wuxibiologics.com.cn/): 大分子 CRDMO 龙头
- [WuXi XDC (药明合联)](https://wuxixdc.com/): ADC / 生物偶联药 CRDMO
- [BioDlink (TOT Biopharm) (东曜药业 / BioDlink)](https://www.biodlink.com/): 生物药与 ADC/XDC CDMO
- [Pharmaron (康龙化成)](https://www.pharmaron.cn/): 多疗法研发生产服务平台
- [Asymchem (凯莱英)](https://www.asymchem.com.cn/): 小分子 CDMO + 新兴业务
- [Porton (博腾股份 / 博腾生物)](https://www.portonpharma.com/): 小分子 API + CGT + 新分子
- [Samsung Biologics (三星生物)](https://samsungbiologics.com/): 全球最大单抗 CDMO
- [Lonza (Lonza 龙沙)](https://www.lonza.com/): 全球最大 CDMO 之一

## Languages
- English is the default (root).
- Chinese is served at /zh/ via Accept-Language edge detection.

## Content sources
- Public company announcements, financial filings and industry media reports.
- Each article links to its original source.
